_comment: The printable files copied into stl/lego/ and what each is for. Quantities are per robot.

ev3-pixy2.what: Crank walker for the EV3 brick, two EV3 large motors and a Pixy2

chassis.stl.purpose: deck with strap slots for the brick, two side panels with the axle row, forward shelf for the head

camera_head.stl.purpose: head with a perforated face for the Pixy2 LEGO edition brackets; print this or camera_head_pantilt, not both

camera_head_pantilt.stl.purpose: head with a slotted top platform for the base plate of the Pixy2 pan-tilt kit; alternative to camera_head
camera_head_pantilt.stl.note: platform size is assumed: measure the kit's base plate first

left_leg.stl.purpose: left leg and foot, fingers at +/-70 mm

right_leg.stl.purpose: right leg and foot, fingers at +/-27 mm

crank_print_4.stl.purpose: crank, 12 mm radius, cross-axle bore and pin bore

gear_16t_print_6.stl.purpose: 16-tooth module 1 spur gear, 5 mm thick, cross-axle bore

fit_coupon.stl.purpose: fit test: cross-axle hole, 4.95 mm pin hole, 5.35 mm bearing hole; print first

pi-zero-2w-51515.what: Crank walker for a Raspberry Pi Zero 2 W with the Build HAT, two 51515 medium angular motors and a Camera Module 2

chassis.stl.purpose: deck with four M2.5 bosses on 58 x 23 mm centres, two side panels with the axle row, forward shelf for the head

camera_head.stl.purpose: head with a 21 x 12.5 mm M2 pattern for the Camera Module 2

left_leg.stl.purpose: left leg and foot, fingers at +/-70 mm

right_leg.stl.purpose: right leg and foot, fingers at +/-27 mm

crank_print_4.stl.purpose: crank, 12 mm radius, cross-axle bore and pin bore

gear_16t_print_6.stl.purpose: 16-tooth module 1 spur gear, 5 mm thick, cross-axle bore

fit_coupon.stl.purpose: fit test: cross-axle hole, 4.95 mm pin hole, 5.35 mm bearing hole; print first

wheeled.what: Extra parts that turn either walker chassis into a two-wheel robot with a third support

post_d43.stl.purpose: support post for the 43.2 mm wheel class: two pins up into the shelf holes, socket for a tip

post_d56.stl.purpose: support post for the 56 mm wheel class: two pins up into the shelf holes, socket for a tip

post_d65.stl.purpose: support post for the 65 mm wheel class: two pins up into the shelf holes, socket for a tip

tip_skid.stl.purpose: drag skid tip for the support post

tip_ball_16p5.stl.purpose: snap-in cup tip for a LEGO 16.5 mm ball (part 54821)

tip_ball_12p7.stl.purpose: snap-in cup tip for a 12.7 mm steel ball

tip_idler_fork.stl.purpose: fork tip carrying the printed idler on a Technic axle

idler_hub.stl.purpose: hub of the 19 mm idler, free on a Technic axle

wheel_solid_cross_d43.stl.purpose: one-piece wheel, Technic cross-axle bore; one 38 x 3 mm O-ring, rolls on 44.8 mm
wheel_solid_cross_d43.stl.note: if this option is chosen; the default printed wheel

wheel_band_cross_d43.stl.purpose: one-piece wheel, Technic cross-axle bore; groove 7 mm wide for a rubber band up to 6 mm wide

hub_tpu_cross_d43.stl.purpose: rigid hub for the TPU tyre, Technic cross-axle bore

wheel_solid_cross_d56.stl.purpose: one-piece wheel, Technic cross-axle bore; one 50 x 3 mm O-ring, rolls on 57.0 mm
wheel_solid_cross_d56.stl.note: if this option is chosen; the default printed wheel

wheel_band_cross_d56.stl.purpose: one-piece wheel, Technic cross-axle bore; groove 7 mm wide for a rubber band up to 6 mm wide

hub_tpu_cross_d56.stl.purpose: rigid hub for the TPU tyre, Technic cross-axle bore

wheel_solid_tt_d65.stl.purpose: one-piece wheel, TT double-flat shaft bore with retaining screw; two 58 x 3 mm O-rings, rolls on 65.2 mm
wheel_solid_tt_d65.stl.note: if this option is chosen; the default printed wheel

wheel_band_tt_d65.stl.purpose: one-piece wheel, TT double-flat shaft bore with retaining screw; groove 7 mm wide for a rubber band up to 6 mm wide

hub_tpu_tt_d65.stl.purpose: rigid hub for the TPU tyre, TT double-flat shaft bore with retaining screw

wheel_solid_horn_d56.stl.purpose: one-piece wheel, plain face to screw to a servo horn; one 50 x 3 mm O-ring, rolls on 57.0 mm
wheel_solid_horn_d56.stl.note: if this option is chosen; the default printed wheel

wheel_band_horn_d56.stl.purpose: one-piece wheel, plain face to screw to a servo horn; groove 7 mm wide for a rubber band up to 6 mm wide

hub_tpu_horn_d56.stl.purpose: rigid hub for the TPU tyre, plain face to screw to a servo horn

tyre_tpu_d43.stl.purpose: tyre, 43.2 mm outside, 4 mm thick, 2 percent stretch, keyed

tyre_tpu_d56.stl.purpose: tyre, 56 mm outside, 4 mm thick, 2 percent stretch, keyed

tyre_tpu_d65.stl.purpose: tyre, 65 mm outside, 4 mm thick, 2 percent stretch, keyed

tt_cradle_print_2.stl.purpose: cradle for a yellow TT gear motor on the outside of a side panel; hole pattern assumed

servo_cradle_print_2.stl.purpose: cradle for a 9 g 360-degree servo on the outside of a side panel; window size assumed

driver_plate.stl.purpose: generic slotted plate for a small motor driver board

fit_bore_tt.stl.purpose: fit test: TT double-flat shaft pocket and screw hole

fit_bore_horn.stl.purpose: fit test: horn face centre hole

fit_tt_cradle.stl.purpose: fit test: TT motor hole pattern, 2 mm slice of the cradle

fit_servo_cradle.stl.purpose: fit test: servo window and ear holes, 2 mm slice of the cradle
